title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard performance but plagued by severe song cuts, especially a missing section of Fire on the Mountain.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a strong Grateful Dead show with clear and well‑balanced sound when the audio is present. Unfortunately the SBD suffers from multiple abrupt edits – notably in Minglewood, Tennessee Jed, Scarlet Begonias, and a major loss in Fire on the Mountain – which detracts from the listening experience despite the otherwise great performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is high (energetic, well‑played) while recording quality is reduced by many cuts; weighted average yields a solid but imperfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and crisp sound when present, but numerous cuts (Minglewood, Tennessee Jed, Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain, intro, Wheel) interrupt continuity; missing third verse of Fire is especially noticeable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well when uninterrupted, though the abrupt edits create gaps that can be jarring for listeners.
